study.question: Can the incumbent retain its observed click quality while removing normalization-only support computation at inference? Observation: candidate.py is byte-identical to g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached (SHA256 63ce570394d1645fffa5950198fbdd6c9a86ef9ac0376c5fc121e12690ab69f6). It constructs/scores70 rows per impression at eval, but only strata0..2 (30 rows) enter any task readout. The other40 affect training Dice moments/derivatives only. The incumbent records click AUC0.666753547526167, p50/p95 batch latency23.5531/23.6526ms and100313.96 examples/sec, versus frozen source bests0.660646940486458 and0.660163362657485. Those are inherited validation observations, not new results. The supplied runtime has no previous execution error and no tensor/data execution interface in this phase.
study.hypothesis: Training-only support can preserve the incumbent learned function with less inference work: retain all70 rows and their full derivatives in training; in eval use the same stored Dice moments to score only the30 readout rows, optionally constructing only these30 rows. Primary source DIN explicitly distinguishes batch moments at training from moving moments at testing, and the pinned UniRank Dice implements BatchNorm1d. Linear/Dice eval operations are rowwise at fixed stored state. This predicts equivalence in exact arithmetic; changed GEMM shapes/order under BF16 may break practical parity, which must be tested. This is an engineering hypothesis about dead computation in this specific model, not a new normalization algorithm, new AUC gain or a priority claim.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived arXiv1706.06978v4 primary text, lines317..336 (especially330..331), and local-activation context. Inherit target-conditioned activation and Dice training/testing distinction. Proposed difference is pruning unused normalization-support rows at inference in the local compressed four-task adaptation; neither exact DIN reproduction nor a globally novel pruning method is claimed.

study.proposed_difference: Introduce a nonlearned inference_support mode. full keeps incumbent compress70/score70; score_pruned retains identical seven-row compression then slices its first3 strata per block before scorer/pooling; fully_pruned invokes the existing three-row _compress_both before that same30-row scorer/pooling. Every mode takes the exact original full path while self.training is true. No new parameters/buffers/RNG, cached data, I/O, training-loss changes or host-contract changes. Three standalone modules implement the staged contrasts. _represent and all residual summaries remain computed because those summaries still feed predictions.
predictions: At a shared complete state_dict, full versus score_pruned preserves compressed readout values/counts; fully_pruned yields mathematically identical first3 assignment rows/counts. All modes return four finite probabilities[B,1], including batch1, final remainder, empty histories, partial/noncontiguous masks and excluded IDs. Host should verify these gates in FP32 and BF16 before interpreting full validation.

Training at identical state/input/mode must produce identical four-task outputs, parameter/input gradients and Dice running-buffer updates across all3 variants and the incumbent. The execution branch is unchanged; there is no training effect or extra mechanism replication from separately training the variants.

Same-state eval expectation: max absolute probability difference <=2e-6 in FP32 and <=2e-3 under frozen BF16, with no normalization-buffer mutation and identical state_dict keys/shapes. These are predeclared diagnostic tolerances, not measured results. Actual metrics and maximum errors must be retained even if a gate fails.

Quality preservation gate on full authorized validation: absolute click AUC difference <=1e-5 and absolute click Logloss difference <=1e-6 from full bridge. Report all4 task AUC/Logloss; apply the same tolerances per task for the stronger claim that every task is preserved. Retain source-best and DIN comparisons, parameter counts and all negative auxiliary effects. Prior incumbent auxiliary AUCs0.77888/0.78761/0.75717 are materially below DIN0.84907/0.86490/0.87018; this intervention does not predict their recovery.

Inference scorer rows decrease70 to30 (57.14% fewer rows, not a57.14% whole-model speedup). fully_pruned also reduces per-block compression rows7 to3. Expected identical32129765 total/336549 dense parameters and unchanged training memory/time within measurement noise. A useful cost result requires >=5% reduction in model-only batch p50 latency relative to full with quality gates passed; also report p95, allocated GPU/wall seconds, full-loader throughput and peak memory rather than selecting a favorable metric.

The score_pruned versus full contrast isolates support scoring removal; fully_pruned versus score_pruned isolates support compression removal. If only one stage helps, retain that stage rather than attributing the other stage an improvement. Cross-load the same state when the host provides that diagnostic to separate arithmetic effects from accidental training divergence; otherwise explicit lack of same-state evidence limits equivalence claims.
falsifiers: Any changed training output/gradient/buffer at identical state/input or failed full-bridge reproduction is an implementation failure, not scientific counterevidence to eval row independence. Stop interpretation and retain charged failed receipts.

If stored-state eval still depends on support rows, or any predeclared numerical/quality gate fails, useful drop-in equivalence is unsupported for that execution path. GEMM precision changes are a possible implementation explanation; do not silently loosen tolerances or call an AUC change a representation improvement.

If quality is retained but model-only p50 improves by less than5%, or p95/throughput reveal a consequential tradeoff, useful whole-model efficiency is unestablished despite fewer arithmetic rows. Report null/negative timing evidence and retain the full reference.

The present experiment cannot establish training-support causality, task-conditioning complementarity, multi-seed superiority, point-in-time deployment validity or broad architectural novelty. It changes no training mechanism.
alternative_explanations: BF16 GEMM shape/kernel/reduction differences can perturb compressed means or scorer logits despite algebraic equivalence; the staged control separates compression and scorer effects.

GPU timing jitter, warmup/caching, host loading cost or differing allocation state can mimic speed changes. Use the frozen host measurement protocol and report all measured costs; any added diagnostic costs consume the same budget.
Accidental eval/training mode, incomplete state transfer or running-buffer divergence can mimic quality changes. Compare complete state_dict and mode, and retain native eval behavior.
Most inference work may lie in embeddings, five residual summaries, four-by-four residual-bank evaluation or loading; pruning scorer support may produce little wall-time benefit.

Observed incumbent superiority follows an adaptive, single-seed validation search. Reused seed bridges establish reproducibility within this setup, not independent mechanism support. No held-out feedback is available.
